description: Semantic/AST-based prevention rules for GlitchDungeon — Godot 4 GDScript (35 files)

rules.name: Function defined but never called (dead code)
rules.message: Function is defined but never called or connected to a signal — dead code (e.g., apply_poison_if_active)
rules.suggestion: Either call the function, connect it to a signal, or remove it

rules.name: Non-deterministic seed generation
rules.message: Dungeon seed uses non-deterministic wall-clock time — daily dungeons differ per player
rules.suggestion: Use deterministic date: var seed = hash('%d-%02d-%02d' % [date.year, date.month, date.day])

rules.name: Texture shared between NPC and enemy scenes
rules.message: NPC and enemy share the same texture — visual confusion for players
rules.suggestion: Create dedicated NPC sprites; do not reuse enemy textures for friendly characters

rules.name: AudioStreamPlayer with null stream
rules.message: AudioStreamPlayer has null stream — no audio files found in project
rules.suggestion: Create assets/audio/ directory and assign valid AudioStream resources
